notes: Every saved invoice gets a PDF in the invoice folder (InvoiceNo_Buyer_to_City_of_Item_by_Firm.pdf). Save & print finds the e-way bill PDF in the e-way bill folder (checks seller and buyer GSTIN, invoice no., amount), fills the e-way bill number, adds the e-way bill as the next page of the invoice PDF and removes it from the folder. If not found: choose the file, or skip below the limit.
